text: The ___ plot displays the φ (phi) and ψ (psi) backbone dihedral angles of each residue and is used to assess whether a protein structure's backbone conformations fall within sterically allowed regions.
explanation: The Ramachandran plot plots φ and ψ dihedral angles against each other; residues falling outside the allowed/favored regions are flagged as outliers and contribute to quality metrics like the MolProbity score. It is one of the standard tools for assessing stereochemical quality of a solved or predicted structure.
